balls.text: zipped in very full just outside leg. Rinku looks for the paddle sweep and misses. Wide not given and Rinku reviews again. Pant, though, seems to be walking off. Is he that confident of this not being overturned, or does he know the ball grazed something? Rinku has moved across his stumps, but would the ball have still been down leg had he been in his original stance? Umpire says yes. And now he checks UltraEdge, only to find out that there is glove involved. KKR did not run either, meaning that they finish on 155!

change of angle makes zero difference to Rinku! Four in a row and Rinku is ripping Rathi to shreds! This is a full toss outside off. Rinku opens up his stance and mauls it over the wide long on fence!
six, six and six! Rinku and the final over of an IPL game - you cannot make this up! Length ball hung up outside off. Rinku shuffles across, fetches it and clobbers it over long on!

my word - this is some shot, and Rinku is weaving his death-overs magic! Floated up into the slot outside off. Rinku goes through the line and creams it over deep extra cover, who was, for some reason, stationed well inside the fence!
going, going, gone! Back of a length outside off. Rinku moves across his stumps and even though he does not middle this fully, he still muscles it over long on!

darted in on a length outside off. Rinku lets it go, hoping for the wide but the ball seems to sneak just inside the tramlines. Rinku not happy with the decision and he reviews. Of course he does. KKR have two left. Might as well chance your luck. And good for Rinku that he took that chance. No part of the ball inside the tramlines, and the wide has been called!
on a length outside off. Rinku has an agricultural mow at it and drags it into the on side. Single denied
speared across the batter a mile outside off. Left alone and called a wide
slower ball on a full length outside off. Rinku throws the kitchen sink at it and shanks it into the pitch. The ball bounces up over Shami and Rinku is content with a single to keep strike
top yorker, following the batter outside leg. Narine clinks it out towards long on
full just outside off. Rinku backs away again before jabbing it out towards sweeper cover
14 off the over already! Slower bumper but this sneaks a tad down leg, which allows Rinku to step inside the line and help it over short fine leg!
four more - Rinku turning it on now! And he brings up his fifty in style too. This is a missed yorker on off. Half-volley in the end and Rinku threads it past extra cover!
Rinku continues to fight! This is a juicy full toss on off. Rinku gives himself oodles of room and carves it over sweeper cover!
sharp bumper on middle and leg, and this climbs up on Rinku. Bowled at 137.6kph and Rinku fends it into the off side to keep strike
short ball and punished! Slower ball too and this sits up outside leg. Rinku has all the time in the world to get inside the line and thump it into the fine leg fence!
low full toss on middle and leg. Narine backs away and flicks it towards deep mid wicket
banged in short on middle and off. Narine spots the length early and sways out of the way
back of a length, following the batter well outside leg. Rinku tucks it off his pads towards deep square leg
slower ball on a back of a length on middle and off. Rinku gets down on one knee and helps it towards long leg
back of a length outside off. Rinku loads up and flays it towards sweeper cover. Good work on the fence to keep it to one
very full outside off. Rinku advances and throws his hands at it. Squirts it off the inside edge towards fine leg. Calls for the second and he has to scramble to make it back
banged in short on middle and leg. Rinku backs away but can only hack it straight to mid wicket
excellent yorker, honing into off. Rinku digs it out towards the bowler
safe! Back of a length on middle and leg. Stops in the surface and Narine clinks it up off the leading edge. Loops just over Shami's head
short and wide outside off. Rinku opens his bat face and runs it down to deep third
low full toss on the pads. Rinku tucks it off his pads towards deep mid wicket
zinged into the blockhole on middle and off. Narine clinks it out enough to the bowler's right and hurtles across to the other end
back of a length in the channel and this zips through. Narine's feet are stuck to concrete, and he gets beaten on the outside. By a margin too
slower ball on a back of a length on off. Rinku waits on it before tugging it towards deep bakcward square leg
slower bumper just outside leg. Rinku swipes at it but is too early into it. Ends up making contact as he is turning around and chops it towards the keeper
nicely done! Back of a length outside off. Rinku peels the outer cover off the ball and knifes it between short third and backward point!

holes out to long on, and Linde is among the wickets too! Floated up full outside off and Ramandeep's eyes light up. He gets down on one knee, hoping to obliterate it over long on but all he manages is a simple chip to Marsh. KKR now seven down, and Rinku is running out of partners!
shortish just outside off. Ramandeep winds up and laces a square cut towards point, who snaps down low to his right and stops it clean
length ball on the pads. Rinku helps it into the square leg region
back of a length just outside off. Rinku goes back and cuts it straight to backward point
flighted up again, on a fullish length on middle and leg. Ramandeep skips down and knocks it to long off
tossed up full on leg. Ramandeep lunges forward and defends
back of a length just outside off. Ramandeep stays back and bunts it into the mid wicket region
carrom ball on a back of a length on middle and leg. Rinku tugs it towards deep backward square leg
short, wide and punished again! Very predictable from Rathi, and Rinku is on top of it now. Throws his hands at it and crashes it over extra cover!
up and over! Wide again but this is shorter, which is what Rinku waits. He sits back in his crease and slaps it over extra cover!
another googly, on a back of a length outside off. Rinku goes wafting at it and only grabs a handful of fresh air
hung up on a back of a length wide outside off. Rinku swishes hard at it but misses
right into the blockhole on off. Ramandeep gets his bat down in time but cannot do much with it. Squeezed out to extra cover
speared in very full on middle and leg. Ramandeep digs it out towards mid wicket
excellent yorker outside off. Ramandeep a touch late to pick it up and cannot jam his bat down in time. Prince did go up in appeal but found no support forthcoming
back of a length outside off. Rinku hops around his crease before dabbing it towards backward point
slower bumper outside off and this balloons over the batter's head. Rinku lets it go and the umpire has to indulge in some more exercise
banged in shorter outside off. Rinku jumps up into the air and looks for the upper-cut. Cannot lay bat on ball again. Gets the wide, though
dug in short outside off. Rinku looks to dab it over the keeper's head but is beaten by the slight extra lift
zipped in full outside off. Ramandeep tips it to backward point. A bit of confusion between the batters but a misfield makes the single a comfortable exercise
pushed in fuller on middle and off. Rinku comes onto the front foot and defends
back of a length just outside off. Rinku hangs back and prods it towards point
back of a length ball on the pads. Ramandeep tucks it off his hips towards deep backward square leg
length ball on middle and off. Ramandeep dinks it into the vacant mid wicket region and has enough time to gallop back for two
back of a length outside off. Rinku reaches out for it and cuts it towards backward point, who dives to his right and saves three potentially
pushed in full on middle and leg. Rinku stays back and defends

a five-for, and Mohsin's dream IPL soars to an even higher cloud! Slanted in full on middle and leg, and this seems to stop in the surface. Bowled at 143.8kph and Anukul, looking to flick it, pops it straight to mid wicket. Simple grab for Badoni in the ring, and Mohsin has five!

another shank, and this time, Green bites the dust! Seems like another cutter, bashed into the track outside off and angling further away. Green tries to muscle it into the leg side and loses all shape. Plinks it up off the splice and Pant calls early to complete the catch in the point region. KKR five down!
full just outside off. Green plants his front foot and tugs it towards mid wicket

Green goes for another big hit, and survives! Back of a length outside off. Green has a wild whoosh across the line and skies it. Rathi charges to his left from fine leg but cannot quite get there. He also looked at Prince (who was at deep square) for a brief moment and that may have caused a delay in him going for the catch
loose ball, and dumped into the stands! Too far down leg and this sits up nicely for Green. He gets inside the line and swipes it over the long leg fence!
slower bumper outside off. Rinku gets up on his toes and hacks it towards deep mid wicket
back of a length on middle and off. Rinku goes back and knocks it to long on
darted in on a length on off. Rinku gives himself a bit of room and chops it off the stumps towards backward point
fired in full on the pads. Helped out into the on side
shortish outside off. Rinku hangs back and cuts it towards sweeper cover
shortish on the pads. Green winds up and hacks it towards deep backward square leg
back of a length on middle and off. Rinku hops back and punches it to long on
back of a length on middle and leg. Rinku tucks it off his pads towards deep square leg
on a length outside off. Green gives himself room and powers it towards sweeper cover
back to back sixes for Green! A bit of a drag-down on middle and off. Green rocks back, opens up his front hip and bulldozes it over wide long on!
Green goes big! Given a hint of air and this lands in the slot just outside leg. Green gives himself swinging room and pumps it over Linde's head!
flighted up full outside off. Rinku comes forward and works it towards deep mid wicket
darted in full on the pads. Green eases it out to deep mid wicket
back of a length on the stumps. Green waits for it before chipping it towards long on
was that a chance?! Length ball outside off. Rinku sits back and swishes at it. Gets an under-edge and the ball cannons off Pant's right thigh. Very, very tough chance
pushed in much fuller on the pads. Rinku tucks it between long on and deep mid wicket, and dashes back for a couple of runs
fired in full on middle and leg. Green comes onto the front foot again and knocks it to long on
angled in full on middle and leg. Green comes onto the front foot and pokes it towards mid wicket
googly floated up full outside off. Driven out to sweeper cover
slower ball on a back of a length on middle and leg. Green lets the ball come to him before dropping it into the on side
shortish again, outside off. Rinku gets up on his toes and helps it down to fine leg
off the mark in style! Shortish just outside off. Rinku spots the length early, swivels nicely and hammers it behind square!
back of a length just outside off. Rinku hangs back and blocks
back of a length just outside off. Rinku gets up on his toes and taps it towards backward point
banged in short outside off. Rinku looks for the upper-cut first ball but fails to lay bat on ball

gloved and gone! They cannot play him! Sharp bumper just outside leg and this skips through. Powell has a swipe at it but the ball gets too big on him too quickly. Brushes the glove on the way, and Pant does the rest. Powell shaking his head in disappointment, and KKR sink further into trouble!
googly, on a back of a length on middle and leg. Green, cramped for room, jabs it towards extra cover
fullish on middle and off. Green gives himself room and cloths it over the bowler's head
shortish on middle and off. Powell hops back and pulls it towards mid wicket
fullish just outside off. Powell comes forward and defends

oh good lord - how have LSG botched this?! Fired in full on the stumps. Powell bunts it to mid wicket. Green hares through, but Powell is staying put at the other end. Prince fields it, runs close to the stumps and then from a couple of yards out, misses. Phew - that is some reprieve. Rathi, it must be mentioned, did noy get back to the stumps to collect any possible throw.
back of a length outside off. Green stays back and pokes it towards mid off

a huge mix-up, but Raghuvanshi survives! Back of a length on middle and off. Raghuvanshi punches it to mid on and sets off, only to be sent back from half-way. He sprawls across the turf and cops a throw from Shami for his troubles. LSG did indulge in a hint of an appeal but the batter did not change direction to get in line with the throw. Well, that is what it seemed like in real-time but the third umpire has now been called into action. Oh wow. Raghuvanshi's turning radius was more than what might be deemed normal. He did look at the ball too, and the third umpire reckons he changed direction. Raghuvanshi has to go, and he is not at all happy. The key question here was how big his turning radius was. It was a little more than what would be deemed normal, and he ended up outside the cut strip while diving. The third umpire seems to agree with that assessment. KKR three down now!
length just outside off. Green gets caught on the crease and pokes it enough to mid wicket's left
hard length, pitching just outside off and nipping in sharply. Raghuvanshi seems to play outside the line, with the ball pinging off his body into the off side
back of a length on middle and leg. Raghuvanshi hangs back and stabs it towards mid wicket
back of a length just outside off. Green pokes it to mid on and saunters across to the other end
back of a length on off. Skids through and Green has a hurried stab at it. Chunks it off the inside edge towards long leg, and scrambles back for two
back of a length but sliding down leg. Easy decision for the umpire once Green misses it
shot! Back of a length outside off. Raghuvanshi rises with the bounce and cracks it on the up through point. That flew to the fence!
back of a length just outside off. Green presses half forward and dabs it behind point to open his tally for the day

sliced up, and Markram sends the KKR skipper on his way! Mohsin doing his thing yet again! Zipped in full and this follows the batter a little outside leg. Rahane wants to go downtown but the bat face opens upon contact. The ball skews off the outer half of the blade and Markram, back-pedalling, snares the chance. KKR in trouble!
back of a length outside off. Raghuvanshi gets up on his toes and jabs it into the cover region
back of a length outside off. Rahane drops it with soft hands behind point and ambles across to the other end
length just outside off. Raghuvanshi lets the ball come to him before dabbing it down to deep third
back of a length outside off. Raghuvanshi throws his hands at it and flays it down to deep third
back of a length outside off. Rahane advances and tips it to extra cover. Calls for the single and scampers across. Mukul's under-arm flick sailed well over the stumps
oh! Back of a length outside off and this nips in sharply. Keeps a touch low too and Rahane, swishing at it, is cut in half. Barely carried through to Pant
pick the bones out of this one! Back of a length outside off. Rahane takes a step down the track, stands up tall and whacks it over the wide long on fence!
back of a length on middle and off. Raghuvanshi skips down the track and punches it just behind square to get off the mark
hard length on middle and off. Nips back in and the ball seems to graze the inside edge as Rahane stabs at it. Off the body and into the off side for a run

plonked to extra cover, and KKR's troubles at the top continue! On a length and agnling across the batter outside off. Seifert looks to go inside-out but does not get under it enough. A rather tame attempt in the end and Mukul gobbles it up. Mohsin with a wicket-maiden to begin, and KKR rocked early, again!
back of a length in the channel and this seams away with the angle. Seifert has a waft at it and only swishes at thin air
full just outside off. Seifert gets a half stride in and pushes it towards mid off

back of a length, finishing on middle and off. Rahane has a wild mow across the line and seems to inside-edge it into his pad. The ball then rolls away into the off side. Mohsin was interested in the lbw and Pant, without a whole lot of consultation, has gone upstairs. Ball Tracking says the ball has pitched a smidgen outside leg, and LSG lose a review!
full just outside off. Rahane gets a half stride in and pokes it back to the bowler
back of a length on off. Rahane wants to drop and run to cover but his partner is not as interested
back of a length outside off. Shapes away late and Rahane, with an open bat face, runs it down to deep third to open his account
back of a length outside off. Rahane gets on top of the bounce and guides it towards backward point. Timed that sweetly but could not pick the gap

another in-swinger but this too tails down leg. Rahane looks for the glance and seems to miss it. Some noise as the ball passes the bat. Called a wide, and LSG review. They might have a case here. The ball may have brushed the thigh pad. UltraEdge confirms the ball has grazed the thigh pad. Decision overturned, and LSG get a review right in the first over!
goes for the in-swinger but errs in line this time. Slides down leg and called a wide once Rahane misses his flick
back of a length outside off, moving away again. Rahane opens his bat face and dabs it towards backward point
back of a length in the channel and this curves away late too. Rahane lets the ball come to him before meeting it right under his eyes
full on middle and off, and shaping away nicely. Rahane comes forward and defends

and we are going into a Super Over! Goodness gracious me! Mohammed Shami, what are you made of?! All those years. All that experience. All that pedigree. And all of it has now unfurled itself when LSG needed it most. Shami, a match-winner for every team with the ball, now pops up with heroics with the bat. In the slot outside off and Shami slams it over long off. Shami storms off, somehow still livid about something. Does he think he should have finished this game off altogether? Well, we will never know. But what we know is that we have a Super Over, and this game, which has ebbed and flowed for the past half an hour, is not done yet!
back of a length outside off and this zips through. Shami swings like a rusty gate and is a week late on the stroke. Clean past the outside edge, and LSG need seven off one now!
well well! Slower ball on a back of a length wide outside off. Prince shuffles across, trying to lap it. Misses it completely and Seifert fumbles again - this time, allowing Shami to pinch a bye

shanked to deep backward square leg, and guess who is there on the fence to pouch it! Rinku could catch a cold in the desert tonight! Shortish outside off. Himmat moves across and looks to mow it leg side. Cannot free his arms fully and his short-arm-jab flies harmlessly towards deep backward square leg. Rinku throws the ball into the turf in frustration, and this could be the game for KKR!
banged in short, and Himmat pounces! LSG believe and their fans believe as well now. Sits up outside off. Himmat swivels and belts it behind square. One bounce and into the fence!

oh, this could be another No ball! Caught at long on, and the No ball has been called! Tyagi wants to review, and this could be an enormous moment in the game! Borderline high full toss, on off stump. Himmat swipes at it and cloths it towards long on. Catch is taken but that may be immaterial for now. All eyes on Ball Tracking. What does Ball Tracking have in store for us here. Proper drama in Lucknow. Himmat's waist is measured at 1.01m, and the ball passes at 1.08m. And to add to KKR's woes, Tyagi may not be allowed to bowl anymore because he has bowled two high full tosses.

oh dear - surely this is going to be a No ball! Chest-high full toss on off and Himmat does well to actually get bat on it and protect himself. Off the splice and into the short mid wicket region, but a Free hit will ensue now!
off-pace and into the track outside off. Shami has a massive swish at it and misses. Seifert fumbles too and Himmat pinches a bye

this is a terrific shot, and Himmat keeps LSG believing! Misses the wide yorker this time but only by a smidgen. That is all Himmat needs, though. He sits deep in his crease and scythes it over point!
slower bumper wide outside off. Shami has a waft at it and upper-cuts it just beyond point. It was in the air but enough to Rahane's left
borderline waist-high full toss outside off. Shami throws the plumbing at it and misses. Not called a No ball, and LSG opt against the review too
Shami wants a piece of the fun too! Right in the slot outside off. Shami gives it the good'ol wind-up and thumps it over the bowler's head!
nails the yorker but it is a little too far beyond the tramlines. Shami swishes and misses, and the wide gets called

chipped straight to long on, and Rinku can do no wrong tonight! Full and spearing into the batter, who is backing away outside leg. Linde checks his whip and the ball carries all the way to Rinku. Half measures from Linde and LSG, and that perhaps sums up how this chase has gone for them. KKR well and truly in the box seat now!
length ball hung up a mile outside off. Himmat does well to reach it but can only cloth it to long off

successive boundaries, and this game is not done yet! Attempted seam-up bumper outside off. Linde fetches it and forehands it towards long on. Ramandeep gets his right hand to it but it is not strong enough to stop the boundary!

Powell sprawls, but he cannot bring this under his spell! Back of a length outside off. Linde is too early into his slap and chips it to long off's right. Powell gives it all he has, diving to his right, but the ball scrapes his palms before dribbling into the fence!
back of a length outside off. Slanted across from over the wicket too and Linde, swishing at it, only swishes at thin air

swatted to deep mid wicket, and Varun is the man for KKR tonight! Back of a length on the stumps. Seems to skid through a touch, meaning that Badoni cannot free his arms fully. Hacks at it anyway and arrows it flat to Roy, who bends down low and picks it up inches off the turf. LSG six down, and in a whole heap of trouble now!
flighted up full just outside off. Himmat gets onto the front foot and drives it to long off
back of a length just outside off. Badoni tries to give himself room but cuts it straight to backward point
full toss wide outside off. Badoni reaches out for it and drills it towards deep point
slower ball on a length wide outside off. Badoni looks to repeat the scooping dose but is too early into the stroke on this occasion
low full toss outside off and Badoni misses out. Throws his hands at it but is a touch late on it. Tyagi will feel he got away with one there
six more! Badoni turning on the style! Full toss outside off. Badoni shimmies across, gets down on one knee and laps it over the fine leg fence!
full just outside off. Himmat hangs back and jabs it towards extra cover. Settles for a single
oh goodness - where have you been, Himmat?! Short, wide and Himmat gives it the treatment it deserves. Serious bat speed through the ball and it flies over deep point!
back of a length outside off. Badoni taps it into the mid wicket region and scampers back for another brace
Badoni is not giving up the ghost! Flighted up into the slot outside off. Badoni goes through the line and carves it beautifully over extra cover!
tossed up on a length on leg. Badoni gives himself a bit of room and bunts it to long on's right. Has enough time to race back for two
back of a length, sliding into the pads. Himmat helps it towards short fine leg, albeit off the thigh pad

catching practice for Rinku at deep mid wicket, and LSG falling apart now! A pat on the back for Rahane too for bringing on Roy. Dragged down on leg. Mukul looks for the big hoick over cow corner but the ball keeps coming in with the angle to cramp him. Cloths it and hits it down Rinku's throat. LSG's chase is flagging; KKR's defence, soaring!
back of a length outside off. Badoni rocks back and cuts it towards deep point
on a length wide outside off. Badoni dabs it towards short third and calls for the single. Completed comfortably enough in the end
shortish outside off. Badoni stays back and cuts it towards backward point, who tumbles to his left and saves four

huge lbw shout, not given! Fired in full on middle and leg. Mukul gets down on one knee and swipes at it. Looks like the ball came off the glove, but KKR think otherwise. KKR go upstairs. Looks liek it will be in vain, though, because the ball seems to have grazed the glove. KKR lose a review, and Mukul stays!
back of a length outside off. Badoni has a waft at it and chops it off the under-edge towards short third
back of a length outside off. Nips away and Badoni, looking to dab it behind point, fails to make contact
back of a length outside off. Badoni hangs back and prods it into the off side

sliced straight to short third, and the plan works a charm! Varun has been trying this all over and it finally yields the desired outcome. Hung up full and wide, tempting Pooran to go inside-out. He throws the plumbing at it but only musters an outside edge. Narine snaffles it up at short third, and Varun lets out a shriek of delight. Pooran is distraught as he walks off, and KKR continue to chip away!
back of a length outside off. Pooran shapes for the cut but is again beaten for pace. Varun firing it in now
shortish outside off. Pooran hangs back and scuffs it towards cover point

pushed in on a length wide outside off. Pooran lets this go too but the umpire has his arms tucked by his side. This time, Pooran will review. And he will be vindicated. Ball is just beyond the tramlines, and the wide has been called now.
back of a length outside off, and this skids through after pitching. Pooran swishes at it and is beaten for pace
wow - this is a shot and a half! Floated up into the slot outside off. Pooran lets his hands flow through the ball and creams it over extra cover!
back of a length outside off. Punched off the back foot towards deep point
back of a length on off. Skids through and Badoni hacks it towards deep mid wicket
back of a length just outside off. Pooran uses the angle from around the wicket and turns it into the square leg region
back of a length just outside off. Badoni goes back and pushes it towards deep point
shortish outside off. Badoni hangs back and cuts it towards backward point

big caught-behind appeal, but the umpire is unmoved! KKR review! Fired in full on middle and off. Pant looks for the reverse this time and seems to miss it. Seifert, though, thinks otherwise and he has convinced his skipper to review. This could be quite close. Ball is very close to the glove. All eyes on UltraEdge now, and....it returns with a spike when the ball is next to the glove. A minute graze off the right glove, and the LSG skipper has to trudge off!
clever, clever batting! And accomplished in true Pant fashion. On a length on off. Pant moves across, ends up on the deck and swipes it over short fine leg!
slower ball hung up on a length wide outside off. Pooran has a wild swish at it and toe-ends it towards the keeper
full, wide and sneaking just inside the tramlines on the off side. Left alone and the wide is not called, rightly
length outside off. Pant opens up the off side and drives it on the up towards sweeper cover
into the blockhole just outside off. Pooran clinks it to mid off and hurtles across to the other end
back of a length outside off. Pant nearly swishes himself off his feet and chops it towards deep point
Pant at his absolute best! Slower ball on a length on middle and off. Pant shuffles across his stumps early and scoops it over short fine leg!
back of a length just outside off. Pooran, cramped for room, prods it towards the bowler
back of a length just outside off. Pant hares down the track and smacks it straight to sweeper cover
back of a length on off. Pooran nudges it towards backward point and gets off the mark
back of a length on off. Pooran gets up on his toes and taps it gently into the off side

oh, this is astonishing! Absolutely world-class! Slot ball outside off. Markram plants his front foot and smashes it flat towards long off. Rinku judges it well, takes it near his right shoulder and then flicks the ball up in the air as he is about to step beyond the rope. He returns to the field of play and complete the catch, and then wheels away in celebration. Splendid work by Rinku, and this could be a game-changer!
on a length outside off and this sticks in the surface. Markram drives at it uppishly and gets it over extra cover. Back for a brace as long off reins it in
slower ball on a back of a length outside off. Markram waits for it and slaps it towards sweeper cover
banged in short outside off and this climbs through. Markram has a huge waft at it but sees the ball whistle past his flailing blade
shortish on off. Pant has a swipe at it but cloths it towards deep square leg
Pant with a shackle-breaking boundary too! Full ball on the pads. Pant brings his wrists into play and whips it past fine leg!
back of a length just outside off. Pant gets up on his toes and turns it towards mid wicket
length ball on middle and Pant gives the new bowler the charge straightaway. Scuffs it to mid off, though
darted in full outside off. Pant comes forward and eases it to long on
shortish outside off. Pant tries to hit it too hard and scuffs it towards extra cover
slanted in on a length on off. Pant dinks it into the square leg region and the ball pulls up just beyond the ring. Easy brace on offer
fuller outside off. Markram stretches forward and pushes it towards long off
Markram breaks the shackles! Back of a length outside off. Markram plants his front foot, stands up tall and launches it clean over long on!
fizzed in full just outside off. Markram looks to drive down the ground but ends up jamming it off the inside edge into his pads
back of a length on the stumps. Markram stabs it towards long on and keeps strike
incoming ball, on a back of a length and finishing on off. Markram, cramped for room, scuffs it towards extra cover
back of a length on the stumps. Pant whips it towards deep mid wicket
back of a length on middle and leg. Markram hangs back again and knocks it to long on
shortish outside off. Pant sits deep in his crease and hacks it towards deep backward square leg
shortish outside off. Markram hops back and punches it towards long off
pushed in on a length just outside off. Pant comes half forward and blocks
tossed up a little more, on a full length on leg stump. Markram squirts it off the inside edge towards fine leg
speared in on a length but also down leg. Markram swishes and misses, and the umpire signals for a wide
back of a length, slanting in and tucking up the batter for room. Markram fends it towards mid wicket
short and wide outside off. Pant throws the kitchen sink at it and slaps it towards sweeper cover
angled in full on the pads. Markram presses forward and knocks it to long on
fullish outside off. Pant opens his bat face and guides it towards short third
this is a Markram special! Full and slanting into the pads. Markram comes forward and lifts up his back leg, whipping it over mid on!
back of a length just outside off. Kicks up a little and Pant drops it into the off side with soft hands
hard length on off. Markram gets up on his toes again and stabs it towards mid on
back of a length outside off. Markram stands up on his toes and punches it towards extra cover
on a length outside off. Pant uses the width and drives it on the up towards deep point
fullish on off. Pant looks to force it down the ground and jams it off the inside edge. Nearly pops up off the pad to the bowler
back of a length on middle and off. Spins in and Pant reads it off the pitch, patting it into the point region for a single
fired in full on the pads. Eased out towards deep mid wicket
back of a length on middle and leg. Pant gets down on one knee and sweeps it towards deep backward square leg
dragged down, and duly put away! Excellent batting. Picks the length early, uses the depth of the crease and hammers it past mid wicket!
back of a length outside off. Pant throws his hands at it and slices it towards backward point
darted in on a length on off. Markram has a swish at it and chunks it off the inside edge towards short fine leg. A bit of a fumble by Arora but no extra runs conceded
back of a length on middle and leg. Markram gets a half stride forward before pushing it between mid on and mid wicket
fullish outside off. Pant bunts it to mid off and canters across to the other end

length just outside off. Pant drives it on the up towards extra cover, who hurtles to his right and stops it. He then hits the stumps at the batter's end and concedes an overthrow in the process. Raghuvanshi the fielder
length just outside off. Pant has a flat-footed stab at it and squirts it off the inside edge towards short fine leg
on a length just outside off. Pant comes half forward and prods it towards the bowler
back of a length outside off, shaping away a touch. Markram hangs back and dabs it behind point
low full toss on middle. Markram pokes it enough to mid on's right and keeps strike
back of a length outside off. Pant rides the bounce again before running it down to deep third
banged in shorter just outside off. Pant rides the bounce and drops it right beside him with soft hands
oh, hello! Enough of the pushing and prodding, says Pant. Dances down to this length ball on leg and smokes it over mid on!
full outside off. Pant gets onto the front foot and drives it towards mid off, where Powell tumbles to his left and stops the boundary
fullish outside off. Pant presses half forward and pokes it into the off side
shortish outside off. Markram rises with the bounce and pushes it towards cover point
back of a length outside off. Pant gets up on his toes and punches it towards deep backward point
hard length on middle and off. Pant gets a half stride in and defends
back of a length just outside off. Pant hangs back and pats it into the off side
angled across on a length outside off. Pant presses forward before letting it go

shanked up, anad taken, eventually! But it looks like it may have come at a cost. Shortish outside off. Marsh has a swipe at it and mistimes it. Powell runs back, gets turned inside out and then lunges to his left to take it near his left shoulder. Another heavy landing, though, and fingers crossed that he is fine. Looks like Powell's left leg is the issue. He is back up on his feet, which is a great sign. But he is walking off, and that dampens the excitement KKR would have otherwise felt having dismissed Marsh early!
classy! Back of a length outside off. Markram sits deep in his crease, gets his hands through the ball and caresses it past extra cover!
shortish on middle and leg. Marsh hops back and tugs it towards deep mid wicket
fired in full on the pads. Markram stabs it out towards deep mid wicket
tossed up full just outside off. Straightens off the surface and Markram, lunging forward, smothers it into the off side
back of a length on the pads. Holds in the surface and Marsh plonks it uppishly towards deep mid wicket
back of a length, angling into the pads. Markram goes back and works it towards deep mid wicket
